basic_details.job_title: MZU Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Mizoram University (MZU) has notified 3 contract vacancies for Guest Faculty posts across Public Administration, Mass Communication, and Civil Engineering departments under GUEST FACULTY ADVERTISEMENT NO. 8 OF 2026. Engagement is strictly on a per lecture basis based on anticipated requirements, with remuneration of Rs. 1,500 per lecture subject to a maximum of Rs. 50,000 per month. Qualifications vary by post, requiring a Master's degree with 55% marks and NET/SLET/SET or Ph.D for Public Administration and Mass Communication, and B.E./B.Tech/B.S. and M.E./M. Tech/M.S. or Integrated M. Tech. i

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for MZU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application by email to [email protected] . Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 06-11-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Mizoram University (MZU) for hiring guest faculty members across multiple specialized departments located in Aizawl, Mizoram.

faq.question: Q2. What are the total vacancies available under this advertisement?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for the Guest Faculty positions across Public Administration, Mass Communication, and Civil Engineering disciplines.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of complete applications by email is 6 November 2026. Candidates must ensure submissions reach before this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for MZU Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted strictly via email by sending the scanned copy of the prescribed application form and supporting documents to the designated department email ID.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary or remuneration offered for these posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive Rs. 1,500/- per lecture, subject to a maximum limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are needed for Public Administration and Mass Communication?
faq.answer: Applicants need a Master's degree with 55% marks in the relevant subject along with cleared NET, SLET, SET, or an awarded Ph.D degree.

faq.question: Q7. What qualifications are required for the Civil Engineering post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E./B.Tech/B.S. and M.E./M.Tech/M.S. or Integrated M.Tech degree in the relevant branch with first class or equivalent.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official notification for applying to these guest faculty positions at Mizoram University.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for the guest faculty positions will be based on performance in an interview conducted by the university.

faq.question: Q10. Where can candidates download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: Candidates can download the official notification, application format (Annexure I), and criteria details from the official website www.mzu.edu.in.
